title: What Birthmark Do You Have?
synopsis: In China, birthmarks are associated with good or bad luck depending on where they grow. Be aware of the two different readings and meanings of 好!

fullText.simplified:
你有什么痣？

    你的脸上或者身上有痣吗？痣简单地说，就是长在皮肤上的小点点，一般是黑色的。别看这小小的痣，不同的痣有不同的寓意。
     在中国，长在脸上不同部位的痣有不同的名字。比如长在嘴巴旁边的痣，叫美人痣；长在下巴的叫好吃痣；长在眼睛下方的叫泪痣……每颗痣也有不同的寓意。比如有美人痣的人会一生感情美满；有好吃痣的人一生都有好口福，经常有机会吃吃喝喝；有泪痣的人寓意一生为爱所苦，被情所困，且容易流泪……痣的寓意有好的也有坏的。手掌或者脚底有痣是好的，这样的人有财运，一生不愁吃不愁穿。相反，脚背有痣是不好的，这样的人运气不太好，终生劳碌。
    当然，这些都是民间的迷信，不足为信。但是直至今日，很多人要点痣时还是会先看看，要点的痣代表的是什么意思。如果要点的痣是寓意好的痣，就不点了，只点寓意不好的痣。
fullText.traditional:
你有什麼痣？

    你的臉上或者身上有痣嗎？痣簡單地說，就是長在皮膚上的小點點，一般是黑色的。別看這小小的痣，不同的痣有不同的寓意。
     在中國，長在臉上不同部位的痣有不同的名字。比如長在嘴巴旁邊的痣，叫美人痣；長在下巴的叫好吃痣；長在眼睛下方的叫淚痣……每顆痣也有不同的寓意。比如有美人痣的人會一生感情美滿；有好吃痣的人一生都有好口福，經常有機會吃吃喝喝；有淚痣的人寓意一生為愛所苦，被情所困，且容易流淚……痣的寓意有好的也有壞的。手掌或者腳底有痣是好的，這樣的人有財運，一生不愁吃不愁穿。相反，腳背有痣是不好的，這樣的人運氣不太好，終生勞碌。
    當然，這些都是民間的迷信，不足為信。但是直至今日，很多人要點痣時還是會先看看，要點的痣代表的是什麼意思。如果要點的痣是寓意好的痣，就不點了，只點寓意不好的痣。

sentence_translations: What Birthmark Do You Have?
Do you have a birthmark on your face or on your body?
Put simply, a birthmark is a small spot that grows on your skin, and is usually black.
Even though they’re just small birthmarks, different birthmarks have different implications.
In China, birthmarks on your face have different names depending on where they grow.
For example, a birthmark next to your mouth is called a beauty birthmark.
If it grows on your chin it's called a glutton birthmark.
If it grows below your eye it's called a tear birthmark.
Each birthmark also has its own implication.
For example, a person with a beauty birthmark will live a happy and full life.
A person with a glutton birthmark will encounter lots of tasty food, and have many opportunities to eat and drink.
A tear birthmark means that throughout life you will suffer for love and be trapped by your feelings, and cry easily.
Birthmarks can have both good and bad meanings.
Birthmarks on your palm or the sole of your foot are good.
People with these have great fortune in money, and will never worry about food or clothes.
On the other hand, having a birthmark on your instep is not good.
People with these have poor luck, and will struggle throughout their life.
Of course, these are just superstitions among the people and are not to be taken seriously.
But even nowadays, when people go to remove birthmarks they will first have a look, ..
.. to see what meaning the birthmark they want to remove has.
If the birthmark they want to remove has a good meaning, then they will not remove it.
They only remove birthmarks with bad meanings.
